name: Austria

sellerFields.label: Legal form and company name (for example GmbH, e.U.)
Chamber (Kammer), trade authority (Aufsichtsbehörde) and trade rules, when they apply

tasks.title: Enter the seller data for the imprint
tasks.detail: The imprint needs your name or company name, address, e-mail, phone, and the Firmenbuch and UID data when you have them. Until you do, the live imprint shows marked gaps.

tasks.title: License your packaging with a collection and recovery scheme
tasks.numberLabel: Licence or contract number of the scheme
tasks.detail: A seller that ships packed goods to buyers in Austria licenses the packaging with an approved collection and recovery scheme. Austria has its own scheme; it is not LUCID. Enter the number here.

tasks.title: Name the product-safety contact in the EU (GPSR)
tasks.detail: Each product needs the name and address of the manufacturer and, for a maker outside the EU, an EU responsible person. Enter them on the product.

tasks.title: Decide on the small-business rule (Kleinunternehmerregelung)
tasks.detail: Austria has its own small-business rule with its own threshold. With the rule, invoices carry the note that no VAT is charged. Ask your tax adviser.

tasks.title: Register for the EU One-Stop-Shop when your EU distance sales pass 10,000 euro a year
tasks.detail: Above the threshold, VAT of the buyer country applies to sales to consumers in other EU countries. Register the OSS through FinanzOnline.

tasks.title: Register electrical products in Austria (WEEE)
tasks.detail: Only when you sell electrical or electronic products. Mark the task NOT_NEEDED when you do not.

storefrontRules: Order button text: 'Zahlungspflichtig bestellen' (or 'Kaufen'); the checkout says it clearly.
Total price with VAT and shipping cost before the order.
Unit price for goods sold by weight, volume, length or area.
Withdrawal within 14 days (FAGG); the withdrawal button is reachable at the bottom of every page.
Product-safety contact on the product page.
Cookie consent only when non-necessary trackers run.

notes.text: Austrian small-business rule: own threshold and invoice note; it differs from section 19 UStG in Germany.
EU One-Stop-Shop: above 10,000 euro of EU distance sales a year, VAT of the destination country applies.
On eBay and Amazon the marketplace collects and reports VAT as facilitator where the law says so.
